selected_gaps.gap: Under a limited initial budget, no retrieved frontier establishes that the observed low-fidelity score preserves the sign and ordering of paper interventions by the performance improvement they later produce on independently specified user tasks; a probe can therefore support the wrong go/no-go decision even when it is internally faithful.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This is the load-bearing method gap because the bottleneck is the cost of deciding the sign of downstream utility, not the cost of producing another artifact. Reframing adoption screening as cost-sensitive sequential experimental design turns heterogeneous minimal reproduction checks into decision-risk-reducing measurements while explicitly avoiding the occupied Hyperband/BOHB node: checks are not configurations on a shared fidelity axis and the objective is the sign of user-task net benefit.

selected_gaps.gap: No retrieved paper tests whether tasks derived from the paper or skill, or selected by a fixed reproduction benchmark, are representative enough of the user's target-task distribution to support an adoption decision.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This sibling shares the anchor's net-benefit object but attacks its task-distribution validity: paper-derived tasks can confound intervention relevance with target utility. The controlled-diagnostic move closes it with user-specified task strata and matched intervention/control runs that vary the paper intervention while holding task, model, environment, scorer, and seed fixed.

deliverable_coverage: method - the anchor gap's reframe_as_solvable_object pattern yields the runnable sequential triage rule that chooses paired minimal reproduction checks and emits adopt, reject, or inconclusive.

deferred_gaps.gap: No retrieved frontier estimates net benefit after execution cost, adaptation effort, and regressions on task dimensions outside the paper's headline metric are deducted from gross performance gain.
deferred_gaps.reason: Deferred as a separate closure leg to keep the candidate focused; cost, adaptation effort, and regressions remain preregistered terms inside the anchor's net-benefit estimand.

deferred_gaps.gap: No retrieved frontier quantifies decision calibration across paper families, user tasks, agent models, environments, and probe budgets, including false-adoption and false-rejection rates.
deferred_gaps.reason: Deferred to future work because a full cross-factor calibration study would expand beyond the anchor and its single user-distribution sibling.
